# gigahost_isos (Data Source)

Lists the account's uploaded ISOs available for deployment. Use a `name` for `gigahost_server.iso`. Same data as `gigahost deploy isos`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the account's uploaded ISOs; names feed gigahost_server.iso.
data "gigahost_isos" "all" {}

output "iso_names" {
  value = data.gigahost_isos.all.isos[*].name
}
```
